identity.title: Modeling the quiet Sun cell and network emission with ALMA

paper_type_evidence.quote: we expand our previous work on modeling the chromospheric temperature of the quiet Sun, by including measurements of the brightness temperature in the network and cell interiors, from high resolution ALMA images

targets.name: Quiet Sun (full disk, cell interior and network regions)

question.value: What are the electron temperature structures of the average quiet Sun, cell interior and network from ALMA Band 3 and 6 images, and how well is the ALMA full-disk absolute calibration known?

evidence.quote: We also examine the absolute calibration of ALMA full-disk images.
ADS/JAO.ALMA#2016.1.00572.S
ADS/JAO.ALMA#2017.1.00653.S
ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00020.SV.
ADS/JAO.ALMA#2019.1.01532.S
high resolution ALMA images at 3 mm (Band 3) and 1.26 mm (Band 6)
providing full-disk (FD) images with a resolution of $\sim60$$''$ in Band 3 and $\sim30$$''$ in Band 6
these images had a resolution of $\sim2$$''$ in Band 3 and $\sim1$$''$ in Band 6

provided.value: 353 GHz center-to-limb data used with ALMA

evidence.quote: together with the observations of (cite: 1993ApJ...415..364B) at 353 GHz

what.value: Recommended disk-center Tb normalization (7300 K Band 3, 5900 K Band 6)

evidence.quote: whereas for Band 6 it is 280 K above the recommended value (6180 K, compared to 5900  K)

what.value: Cell and network Tb values near disk center at 100 GHz

evidence.quote: values derived from (cite: 2019ApJ...877L..26L) at 100 GHz near the center of the disk, measured from the histograms of their Figure 2a

simulations_or_models_as_data.value: FAL93 models A, C, F and VAL81 segregation compared with measurements; rMHD model of Wedemeyer et al. 2020

evidence.quote: the cell and network values (a single set at 100 GHz, $\mu=1$) form the radiative MHD model of (cite: 2020A&A...635A..71W) are plotted

flux_scale_uncertainty.value: Systematic uncertainty of order 5% in the White et al. FD calibration, considered too low

evidence.quote: a systematic uncertainty of order 5% comes in through the product of the “forward scattering and spillover” coefficient and the “forward efficiency”.

self_calibration.value: Feathered HR images improved by self-calibration

evidence.quote: In both cases we used “feathered” images, improved by self-calibration
whereas the radius used for Band 6 was 17.5$''$

array_combination.value: HR interferometric data feathered with FD images

evidence.quote: “feathered” images (combining HR interferometric data with FD)

what.value: Diffuse-light correction and no-sky-background assumption for FD images

evidence.quote: the observed $T_b$ was corrected for diffuse light as explained in Paper I (Section 3 and Figure 4)

what.value: 2017 observation targets and cell/network equal-pixel split

evidence.quote: (Table 1 of Paper II)

unstated_but_needed: Imaging, feathering and self-calibration parameters for HR data
Details of the inversion procedure from Tb(mu) to Te(tau) beyond log fit
Details of how network/cell pixel selection thresholds were applied across regions
Data of April 12 2018 observations not given a project code

method.value: Least-square fit of all FD sets to a common linear function of log mu at 100 GHz; Band 3 factor set to unity

evidence.quote: we set the normalization factor for that at unity, leaving the factors for the other data sets to be determined by the fit.

key_parameters.value: Reduction to f_ref = 100 GHz via Tb((f/fref)^2 mu, fref)=Tb(mu,f)

evidence.quote: we had reduced all data to a common reference frequency, $f_{ref}$

assumptions.value: Commissioning calibration correct; opacity proportional to f^-2

evidence.quote: assuming that the commissioning calibration was correct
Here a linear fit function was used, as a quadratic fit made no difference.

validation.value: rms deviation about 20 K; feathered/FD comparison factor 1.066

evidence.quote: with a root mean square (rms) deviation of about 20 K for the ALMA data

method.value: Tb(mu)=a1+a2(ln mu - gamma) giving Te=a1+a2 ln tau

evidence.quote: T_b(\mu)=a_1+a_2(\ln\mu-\gamma)
is valid up to $\mu\simeq0.15$ ($\sim10$$''$ from the limb)

validation.value: Scatter of single-day inversions gives error estimates

evidence.quote: which gives $\delta a_1=14$ K and $\delta a_2=15$ K.

method.value: Pixel segregation: set 1 equal split; set 2 lowest 8% cell, top 4% network; HR values corrected to match global inversion

evidence.quote: attributing the lowest 8% of the pixels to cell interior and the top 4% to the network

fitting.value: Linear regression of Tb vs log mu100, inverted to Te(tau100)

evidence.quote: together with the corresponding linear regression lines and FAL93 models
the Band 6 average value (6343 K) is 443 K or 7.5% above the recommended (5900 K)

results_numeric.quantity: Network-cell Te difference at tau100=1 (set 1 / set 2)

evidence.quote: 2.4 Mm in Band 6 and 4.2 Mm in Band 3

findings_qualitative.value: Network/cell Te curves diverge with decreasing tau, suggesting steeper temperature rise in network

evidence.quote: indicating an increase of contrast with height and possibly a steeper temperature rise in the network than in the cell interior.

claims.hypothesis: ALMA FD Band 6 normalization recommended by White et al. is correct
claims.experiment: Fit all FD sets to common Tb-log mu relation
claims.finding: Recommended Band 6 disk-centre Tb is ~440 K too low

evidence.quote: normalization factor recommended by (cite: 2017SoPh..292...88W) for ALMA Band 6 is underestimated by 7.5%, or $\sim440$ K.

claims.experiment: Measure cell and network Tb in HR images, invert to Te
claims.finding: Cell hotter than model A, network cooler than model F

evidence.quote: Our measurements give a much lower network-to-cell contrast than the FAL93 models

limitations_admitted.value: Poor statistics of HR data and reliance on commissioning calibration

evidence.quote: In spite of the poor statistics

referee_caveats_inferred: Normalization anchored to assumed-correct commissioning values

reproducibility.score_reason: Data identified but processing and inversion details are sparse.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Recipe incomplete; relies on inherited Paper I/II procedures.
